== Acquisition ==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
* [[Jarimiya the Unmerciful]] ([[Vehtendi Valley]])

== Notes ==
* This skill has a {{3/4}} second [[aftercast delay]] despite not being a spell, in line with any shadow step skill that has an activation time.
* [[Wild Throw]] has a similar drawback, but instead disables non-spear attack skills.
* Heroes will use this skill indiscriminately on the foes which cannot be knocked down because of [[Stun Immunity]].
